data.one_liner: A collection of convenient widgets and utils made by mono.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of convenient widgets and utilities created by mono. Includes specialized widgets, UI helpers, and helper functions under active construction.
use_when: You need a set of custom convenience widgets and utilities used by mono
You want helper widgets like DelayedPopScope and PageSwitcher
avoid_when: You require a stable and fully documented widget library without frequent breaking changes
You want a specialized library with a single focused purpose
strengths: Includes ready-to-use custom widgets and utilities
Integrates with popular packages like riverpod and go_router
weaknesses: Under construction with frequent breaking changes
Limited documentation beyond a simple description and changelog
data.setup_notes: Add mono_kit to pubspec.yaml and import as needed.
